Name: Tiny Mountain Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Courier New][size=3][u][b]features[/b][/u][/size][/font]

* replaces vanilla [b]hill-top [/b](mining) farm
* small, neat farming area - all grass tillable
* water troughs to refill watering can
* minecart shortcut from house to quarry
* compatible with sve, svr, and fam cave mods


[b][font=Courier New][size=3][u]installation[/u][/size][/font]

[/b]1. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]
2. download this mod and open up the .zip folder
3. extract [b][CP] Tiny Mountain Farm[/b] to [b]/Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]
4. run the game with smapi and start a new save on the [b]hill-top [/b]farm
